title: Mount Nyangani as a UFO repair facility

tellings.quote: Uh what I found out about that one was that it seems to be a repair facility.

plain: Mount Nyangani, a mountain in Zimbabwe, is a repair facility for UFOs, according to a former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan. He speaks from his own experience and says that what he "found out about that one was that it seems to be a repair facility." If he is right, the mountain would be a place where unknown craft go to be fixed.
